desc: Derive the exact Kasteleyn matrix for the medial graph of the H×W torus grid with the given face constraints, mapping type A (turn) and type B (straight) to appropriate edge weights, and verify that counting FPL with these weights yields the desired number of cycle covers.
Implement the four Kasteleyn determinants (spin structures) using a block tridiagonal determinant algorithm (e.g., continuants) that runs in O(HW) time.
Combine the four determinants (with signs according to spin structure) to compute the total number of valid placements modulo 998244353.
Test the implementation on the sample inputs and debug any discrepancies.
Optimize the solution to handle HW up to 10^6 efficiently, ensuring it fits within time limits.
